title: Multi‑Table Sales Report 🧾
description: Join three tables and aggregate to produce a sales summary.
problemStatement:
## Task: Product Sales by Category

Consider three tables:

**products** (product_id, product_name, category)
|product_id|product_name|category|
|---|---|---|
|1|Widget|A|
|2|Gadget|A|
|3|Doohickey|B|

**orders** (order_id, customer_id, order_date)
|order_id|customer_id|order_date|
|---|---|---|
|101|1|2024-01-10|
|102|2|2024-01-12|
|103|1|2024-02-05|

**order_items** (order_item_id, order_id, product_id, quantity, price)
|order_item_id|order_id|product_id|quantity|price|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|1|101|1|2|10|
|2|101|2|1|20|
|3|102|1|3|10|
|4|103|3|1|15|

1. Write a query to show each order with its products: order_id, product_name, quantity, price, and line total (quantity * price). Join orders, order_items, products.
2. Calculate total revenue (sum of line totals) per product category. Show category and total_revenue.
3. List categories with total revenue greater than 50.

**Expected outputs:**

Query 1:
```
101|Widget|2|10|20
101|Gadget|1|20|20
102|Widget|3|10|30
103|Doohickey|1|15|15
```

Query 2:
```
A|70   (Widget: 2*10 + 3*10 = 50, Gadget: 1*20 = 20, total A=70)
B|15   (Doohickey 1*15=15)
```

Query 3:
```
A|70
```
hints: Join: orders o -> order_items oi -> products p on respective keys.
Category revenue: GROUP BY p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.price).
expectedOutput:
Query 1:
101|Widget|2|10|20
101|Gadget|1|20|20
102|Widget|3|10|30
103|Doohickey|1|15|15

Query 2:
A|70
B|15

Query 3:
A|70
solutionCode:
SELECT o.order_id, p.product_name, oi.quantity, oi.price, oi.quantity * oi.price AS line_total
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id;
--
SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.price) AS total_revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.category;
--
SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.price) AS total_revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.category
HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * oi.price) > 50;
